attendance_corrections_time_required.name: attendance_corrections_time_required
attendance_corrections_time_required.value:
"attendance_corrections"."type" not in ('add_check_in', 'add_check_out', 'adjust_check_in', 'adjust_check_out')
        or "attendance_corrections"."proposed_time" is not null

attendance_days_out_after_in.name: attendance_days_out_after_in
attendance_days_out_after_in.value: "attendance_days"."last_out" is null or "attendance_days"."first_in" is null or "attendance_days"."last_out" >= "attendance_days"."first_in"

attendance_days_non_negative_minutes.name: attendance_days_non_negative_minutes
attendance_days_non_negative_minutes.value:
("attendance_days"."worked_minutes" is null or "attendance_days"."worked_minutes" >= 0)
        and ("attendance_days"."late_minutes" is null or "attendance_days"."late_minutes" >= 0)
        and ("attendance_days"."early_departure_minutes" is null or "attendance_days"."early_departure_minutes" >= 0)

manual_attendance_entries_time_required.name: manual_attendance_entries_time_required
manual_attendance_entries_time_required.value: "manual_attendance_entries"."kind" not in ('check_in', 'check_out') or "manual_attendance_entries"."occurred_at" is not null

invoices_issued_dates.name: invoices_issued_dates
invoices_issued_dates.value: ("invoices"."lifecycle_status" = 'draft' and "invoices"."issued_on" is null and "invoices"."due_on" is null) or ("invoices"."lifecycle_status" <> 'draft' and "invoices"."issued_on" is not null and "invoices"."due_on" is not null and "invoices"."due_on" >= "invoices"."issued_on")

commercial_contracts_amount_currency_pai.name: commercial_contracts_amount_currency_pair
commercial_contracts_amount_currency_pai.value: ("commercial_contracts"."amount" is null and "commercial_contracts"."currency" is null) or ("commercial_contracts"."amount" is not null and "commercial_contracts"."currency" is not null)

client_documents_one_context.name: client_documents_one_context
client_documents_one_context.value:
("client_documents"."commercial_contract_id" is not null)
        + ("client_documents"."opportunity_id" is not null)
        + ("client_documents"."project_id" is not null)
        + ("client_documents"."invoice_id" is not null) <= 1

client_audit_entries_actor_pair.name: client_audit_entries_actor_pair
client_audit_entries_actor_pair.value: ("client_audit_entries"."actor_type" = 'system' and "client_audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is null) or ("client_audit_entries"."actor_type" = 'user' and "client_audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is not null)

projects_completion_state.name: projects_completion_state
projects_completion_state.value: ("projects"."status" = 'completed' and "projects"."completed_on" is not null) or ("projects"."status" <> 'completed' and "projects"."completed_on" is null)

opportunities_value_currency_pair.name: opportunities_value_currency_pair
opportunities_value_currency_pair.value: ("opportunities"."estimated_value" is null and "opportunities"."currency" is null) or ("opportunities"."estimated_value" is not null and "opportunities"."currency" is not null)

opportunities_conversion_pair.name: opportunities_conversion_pair
opportunities_conversion_pair.value: "opportunities"."converted_at" is null or "opportunities"."client_id" is not null

client_contacts_reachable_channel.name: client_contacts_reachable_channel
client_contacts_reachable_channel.value: "client_contacts"."status" <> 'active' or nullif(trim("client_contacts"."phone"), '') is not null or nullif(trim("client_contacts"."email"), '') is not null

employment_contracts_signed_date.name: employment_contracts_signed_date
employment_contracts_signed_date.value: "employment_contracts"."status" not in ('signed', 'ended') or "employment_contracts"."signed_on" is not null

workforce_documents_one_owner.name: workforce_documents_one_owner
workforce_documents_one_owner.value:
("workforce_documents"."person_id" is not null)
        + ("workforce_documents"."cosigner_id" is not null)
        + ("workforce_documents"."employment_contract_id" is not null) = 1

branch_working_days_within_one_day.name: branch_working_days_within_one_day
branch_working_days_within_one_day.value: "branch_working_days"."opening_time" is null or "branch_working_days"."closing_time" is null or "branch_working_days"."closing_time" > "branch_working_days"."opening_time"
